sloka: भङ्क्त्वा प्रासादशिखरं नाम विश्राव्य चात्मनः ।विनद्य सुमहानादमुत्पपात विहायसम् ।। ६.४१.८९ ।।।।
transliteration: bhaṅktvā prāsādaśikharaṁ nāma viśrāvya cātmanaḥ ।vinadya sumahānādamutpapāta vihāyasam ।। 6.41.89 ।।।।

translations.english: Then as the courageous Vali's son landed on the high peak of the palace which resembled a mountain peak, Ravana stood looking.
